targetUser: potato cooperative members in Musanze who need trustworthy information about the team
problem: Visitors cannot tell which teammate built which part of AgriSoko Pocket or which evidence supports the claim.
contribution: Built the deterministic retrieval pipeline: member document schema, TF-IDF word and character features, cosine ranking, alias boost, confidence threshold and the evaluation query suite.
outcomeMetric: Synthetic fixture only: top-1 accuracy 12/12 on the name, role and feature queries; no-match rejection 5/5 at threshold 0.45.

testerFeedback.quote: The alias query returned the right person and showed why it matched.

introductionDraft: My name is Aline. I am the AI and data engineer of AgriSoko Pocket. I built the deterministic member-matching engine: it turns each approved profile into a searchable document, ranks it with TF-IDF word and character features, applies a documented alias boost and rejects weak matches below the confidence threshold. The evaluation suite is in the repository and the model details are shown in the app.

targetUser: cooperative members in Kinigi who check team and price information on Android phones
problem: The team profiles were hard to reach on a phone and the layout broke with large accessibility text.
contribution: Built the mobile screens and typed navigation: home, ask, result, directory and profile, plus accessible cards, confidence display and safe external links.
feature: Profile result screen and typed app navigation
outcomeMetric: Synthetic fixture only: 4 of 4 scripted screen-flow checks passed; two large-text layout issues found in review were fixed.

testerFeedback.quote: The profile shows the contribution and the evidence links without crowding the screen.

introductionDraft: My name is Eric. I am the mobile UI and navigation engineer of AgriSoko Pocket. I built the React Native screens that let a visitor ask a question, read the matched profile and follow its evidence links. I used typed navigation parameters, reusable components and accessible labels so the result stays usable on a small Android screen and with large text.

targetUser: the mobile app and demonstration visitors who need a reliable online answer
problem: The AI engine needed a stable, validated HTTP contract that never returned unapproved profile fields.
contribution: Built the FastAPI service: health, members, ask and model-info endpoints, Pydantic request validation, safe error responses and the response schema shared with the mobile app.
feature: FastAPI ask endpoint with grounding controls
outcomeMetric: Synthetic fixture only: 6 API contract tests passed, including empty query, unknown member and no-match behaviour.

testerFeedback.quote: When I typed an empty question the app explained the problem instead of sending a request.

introductionDraft: My name is Claudine. I am the API and integration engineer of AgriSoko Pocket. I built the FastAPI contract that connects the mobile app to the matching engine. Every response is validated, limited to approved member fields and carries the model version, confidence and dataset fingerprint so the app can show where an answer came from.

targetUser: visitors in rooms with weak or no network coverage in Musanze
problem: A network failure used to erase the last useful answer and gave no indication whether a result was live or stored.
contribution: Built offline storage and connectivity handling: bundled directory, AsyncStorage cache, exact name/alias/role lookup, source labels, timeout and retry states.
feature: Offline exact-name lookup with cache source labels
outcomeMetric: Synthetic fixture only: 3 of 3 offline lookup checks passed in airplane mode; one stale-label defect was reproduced and fixed.

testerFeedback.quote: In airplane mode the app still found Eric and clearly said it was an offline match.

introductionDraft: My name is Samuel. I am the offline and quality engineer of AgriSoko Pocket. I built the offline path: the approved directory is bundled and cached, exact name, alias and role questions are answered without a network, and every result is labelled live, cached or offline. I also reproduced the timeout and stale-cache defects and linked each fix to an issue.
